open_version_questions: Neither PDF prints NCT05832918; a second reviewer must confirm the official-registry file binding.
review_requirements: Confirm that the exact-title same-day pair dated 27 March 2023 is the governing prerecruitment NCT05832918 pair.
Resolve the six-weeks times three-sessions schedule versus the stated 16-session total and its immediate post-treatment anchor.
Reconcile whether VAS pain and ODI disability are co-primary or whether ODI alone is confirmatory.
Preserve the randomized between-group longitudinal contrast; do not replace it with within-group post-hoc tests or Friedman alone.
Use the prospective protocol target of 34 rather than any later registry enrollment target.
Complete population, estimand, missingness, multiplicity, effect-interval, software and safety specifications.
Verify every critical locator against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages.
notes: First-pass evidence-backed annotation. The one-page reference is prospective and independent and adds methods absent from the model-visible protocol, but its generic mixed-ANOVA and fallback statements do not fully represent the three-timepoint randomized design or the many repeated postural conditions.
